---
title: "Where must the missing 340 g sit to balance inside the CG band?"
subtitle: "The reconstruction predicts 1021 g against 1361 g published, so 340 g of glue, doublers and finish is unmodelled, and where it sits decides whether the published CG band is reachable."
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
#| echo: false
ENTRY_CEILING = 150.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 500.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 1.8      # s the probe actually used

from scipy.optimize import root_scalar

targets = check_reconstruction(airplane, dry_mass_props, cg_aft_le)
published_mass = targets["Dry mass"]["target"]
cg_target_nom = wing_x_break + targets["CG aft LE"]["target"]
cg_target_min = cg_target_nom - targets["CG aft LE"]["tol"]
cg_target_max = cg_target_nom + targets["CG aft LE"]["tol"]

missing_mass = published_mass - dry_mass_props.mass

def balance_residual(x_m, target_cg_x):
    total = dry_mass_props + asb.MassProperties(mass=missing_mass, x_cg=x_m)
    return total.x_cg - target_cg_x

x_missing_nom = root_scalar(balance_residual, args=(cg_target_nom,), bracket=[0.0, fuse_total_length]).root
x_missing_min = root_scalar(balance_residual, args=(cg_target_min,), bracket=[0.0, fuse_total_length]).root
x_missing_max = root_scalar(balance_residual, args=(cg_target_max,), bracket=[0.0, fuse_total_length]).root

window_missing_mm = (x_missing_max - x_missing_min) * 1000
le_rel_min_mm = (x_missing_min - wing_x_break) * 1000
le_rel_nom_mm = (x_missing_nom - wing_x_break) * 1000
le_rel_max_mm = (x_missing_max - wing_x_break) * 1000

cg_aft_le_min_mm = (cg_target_min - wing_x_break) * 1000
cg_aft_le_max_mm = (cg_target_max - wing_x_break) * 1000

# Distribution matching foam centroid
cg_with_foam_finish = (dry_mass_props.mass * dry_mass_props.x_cg + missing_mass * x_foam) / published_mass
cg_aft_le_foam_mm = (cg_with_foam_finish - wing_x_break) * 1000
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{x_missing_nom*1000:.0f} mm"`]{.hero-value}
[nominal longitudinal station from nose for unmodelled mass to balance at target CG]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The [initial reconstruction](2026-10-07-01-can-we-reconstruct-the-ft-f-16-viper-within-tolerance.qmd) revealed a [`{python} f"{missing_mass*1000:.0f}"` g]{.key} shortfall between predicted airframe mass ([`{python} f"{dry_mass_props.mass*1000:.0f}"` g]{.key}) and published dry mass ([`{python} f"{published_mass*1000:.0f}"` g]{.key}). To balance the assembled airframe inside the published center-of-gravity band ([`{python} f"{cg_aft_le_min_mm:.1f}"`--`{python} f"{cg_aft_le_max_mm:.1f}"` mm]{.key} aft of the wing leading edge break), the centroid of this unmodelled mass must sit between [`{python} f"{x_missing_min*1000:.1f}"` mm]{.key} and [`{python} f"{x_missing_max*1000:.1f}"` mm]{.key} from the nose (@fig-missing-mass-balance). Measured relative to the break, this allowable window spans [`{python} f"{window_missing_mm:.1f}"` mm]{.key} (from [`{python} f"{le_rel_min_mm:.1f}"` mm]{.key} to [`{python} f"{le_rel_max_mm:.1f}"` mm]{.key}). The nominal balance point lands at [`{python} f"{x_missing_nom*1000:.1f}"` mm]{.key} ([`{python} f"{le_rel_nom_mm:.1f}"` mm]{.key} aft of the break).

Crucially, this allowable band spans the structural core: the wing root joiner, internal intake ducting, electronics bay, and canopy junction ($x \approx$ [`{python} f"{wing_x_break*1000:.0f}"`--`{python} f"{(x_foam*1000):.0f}"` mm]{.key}). Hot glue, plywood reinforcements, and paper finish naturally concentrate in this center-fuselage region. If the unmodelled mass simply shares the Maker Foam cut centroid ([`{python} f"{x_foam*1000:.0f}"` mm]{.key}), the finished airframe balances at [`{python} f"{cg_aft_le_foam_mm:.1f}"` mm]{.key} aft of the leading edge—comfortably within the published envelope without requiring corrective ballast.

```{python}
#| label: fig-missing-mass-balance
#| fig-cap: "Longitudinal balance zones and sensitivity of finished dry center of gravity to unmodelled mass centroid, showing published target band, allowable 340 g station window, and foam centroid placement."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(
    2, 1, figsize=(8, 6.5), sharex=True, gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": [1, 1.3]}
)

# Panel 1: Airframe profile & longitudinal stations
ax1.set_title("Viper Airframe Stations and Balance Zones", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
x_fuse = [x.xyz_c[0] * 1000 for x in fuselage.xsecs]
w_fuse = [(x.width * 500 if x.width is not None else x.radius * 1000) for x in fuselage.xsecs]
ax1.fill_between(x_fuse, [-w for w in w_fuse], w_fuse, color="#d0d7de", alpha=0.5, label="Fuselage loft")

ax1.plot([wing_x_root * 1000, wing_x_break * 1000, wing_x_tip * 1000],
         [wing_y_root * 1000, wing_y_break * 1000, wing_semi_span * 1000],
         color="#0969da", lw=1.5, label="Wing LE")
ax1.plot([wing_x_root * 1000, wing_x_break * 1000, wing_x_tip * 1000],
         [-wing_y_root * 1000, -wing_y_break * 1000, -wing_semi_span * 1000],
         color="#0969da", lw=1.5)

ax1.axvspan(x_missing_min * 1000, x_missing_max * 1000, color="#fb8f44", alpha=0.3,
           label=f"Allowable 340 g window ({x_missing_min*1000:.0f}–{x_missing_max*1000:.0f} mm)")
ax1.axvline(x_missing_nom * 1000, color="#cf222e", ls="--", lw=1.5,
            label=f"Nominal 340 g station ({x_missing_nom*1000:.0f} mm)")

ax1.axvspan(cg_target_min * 1000, cg_target_max * 1000, color="#2da44e", alpha=0.35,
           label=f"Published CG band ({cg_target_min*1000:.0f}–{cg_target_max*1000:.0f} mm)")

ax1.scatter([x_cg_dry * 1000], [0], color="#8250df", s=50, zorder=5, label=f"Model dry CG ({x_cg_dry*1000:.0f} mm)")
ax1.scatter([x_foam * 1000], [0], color="#1a7f37", marker="s", s=40, zorder=5, label=f"Foam centroid ({x_foam*1000:.0f} mm)")
ax1.scatter([x_edf * 1000], [0], color="#24292f", marker="D", s=40, zorder=5, label=f"EDF station ({x_edf*1000:.0f} mm)")

ax1.set_ylabel("Lateral offset (mm)")
ax1.set_ylim(-250, 250)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.25)
ax1.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=7.5, ncol=2)

# Panel 2: Resulting Total CG vs Missing Mass Station
x_sweep = np.linspace(550, 950, 201)
cg_sweep = (dry_mass_props.mass * dry_mass_props.x_cg * 1000 + missing_mass * x_sweep) / published_mass
cg_aft_sweep = cg_sweep - wing_x_break * 1000

ax2.plot(x_sweep, cg_aft_sweep, color="#0969da", lw=2, label="Finished dry CG aft LE")
ax2.axhspan(25.4, 38.0, color="#2da44e", alpha=0.25, label="Published CG band (25.4–38.0 mm)")
ax2.axhline(31.7, color="#2da44e", ls=":", lw=1.5, label="Published nominal CG (31.7 mm)")

ax2.axvspan(x_missing_min * 1000, x_missing_max * 1000, color="#fb8f44", alpha=0.2)
ax2.axvline(x_missing_min * 1000, color="#fb8f44", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax2.axvline(x_missing_max * 1000, color="#fb8f44", ls="--", lw=1.2)
ax2.axvline(x_missing_nom * 1000, color="#cf222e", ls="--", lw=1.5)

ax2.scatter([x_missing_nom * 1000], [31.7], color="#cf222e", s=60, zorder=5,
            label=f"Nominal balance: $x={x_missing_nom*1000:.0f}$ mm")
ax2.scatter([x_foam * 1000], [cg_aft_le_foam_mm], color="#1a7f37", marker="s", s=50, zorder=5,
            label=f"Foam-distributed finish: {cg_aft_le_foam_mm:.1f} mm")

ax2.set_xlabel("Longitudinal station of unmodelled 340 g mass from nose (mm)")
ax2.set_ylabel("Finished dry CG aft wing LE break (mm)")
ax2.set_xlim(550, 950)
ax2.set_ylim(10, 50)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.25)
ax2.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
